published_ranges._notes: Product-page settings are single points, not ranges: 'Extruder: 350°C', 'Bed: 150°C + (the hotter the better)', 'Bed Prep: PC or PEI sheet'. Not entered as nozzle range fields. 350°C nozzle and 150°C bed exceed Bambu X1/P1 hardware (Bambu X1-Carbon spec sheet: 'Max Hot End Temperature 300'; 'Max Build Plate Temperature 110 @220 V, 120 @110 V'); record only. Made from SABIC ULTEM 9085 resin. 2.85mm 3kg SKU exists on pushplastic.com. 'Generic PEI' preset existence in Bambu Studio not confirmed. Earlier entry: Made from SABIC ULTEM 9085 resin. Density 1.34 g/cm3 is from the SABIC resin TDS that Push Plastic hosts, not a filament test. Must be dried before printing. Nozzle range is above the 300C hotend limit of Bambu X1/P1/P2S; only its 350C lower bound is reachable on a 350C hotend - effectively not printable on Bambu printers. No Bambu Studio PEI preset; bambu_parent omitted.
